title: abutilon sandwicense
intro: Abutilon sandwicense, commonly known as the Ma'o hau hele, is a flowering plant native to the Hawaiian Islands. It has been used in traditional Hawaiian medicine for its various health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Ma'o hau hele include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its ability to soothe and protect the skin. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
